name: Strawberry Shortcake
instructions: Toss sliced strawberries with 3 tbsp sugar. Let sit 30 minutes to macerate.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Mix flour, 2 tbsp sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Cut in cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in heavy cream until dough just comes together.
Drop 8 mounds onto prepared sheet. Bake 12-15 minutes until golden.
Split shortcakes in half. Top with strawberries and whipped cream.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use coconut cream (chilled and whipped) and dairy-free butter.
substitutions.vegan: Use coconut oil and chilled coconut cream.
